subject.title: fix(android): restore the complete Wear companion experience

question: Should the Wear companion’s persisted theme and Auto-Speak settings use this new platform `SharedPreferences` store, or must they be moved into an existing approved OpenClaw SQLite-backed state owner before merge?
rationale: This is a durable state-ownership and upgrade-contract decision, not a mechanical correction: the repository policy requires one canonical owner, while the proposed store introduces a new persisted contract.

options.title: Use an approved canonical state owner
options.body: Move the two settings to the owner-approved canonical persistence path and add focused fresh-install and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Approve Watch-local preferences explicitly
options.body: Accept `SharedPreferences` as the Watch-specific durable owner and document the ownership and upgrade contract before merge.

recommendation.title: Use an approved canonical state owner
recommendation.body: Move the two settings to the owner-approved canonical persistence path and add focused fresh-install and upgrade coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the new settings owner and can provide the implementation context; final product and storage approval remains with the relevant Android owner.
